title: Mosaic Wall
shortDescription: A collective visual wall that assembles photos, drawings, or contributions into a growing mosaic.
longDescription: A large-scale visual composition that turns individual contributions into a shared final image or evolving wall. Inputs can come from photos, avatars, votes, drawings, or generated media, making the experience both personal and collective. Ideal for participation campaigns, community activations, and events that want to visualise togetherness in a single memorable output.

highlights.title: Everyone Adds a Piece
highlights.description: Each visitor contributes a photo, a drawing, an avatar, or a vote and watches it join a shared wall in real time, so a room full of individuals builds one thing together.

highlights.title: Any Kind of Input
highlights.description: Feed the wall with photos, hand drawings, avatars, votes, or AI-generated media, and mix input types to match the campaign, the audience, and the level of effort you want to ask for.

highlights.title: One Memorable Shared Output
highlights.description: Hundreds of small contributions resolve into a single large-scale image that makes togetherness visible in the moment and lives on as a recap people want to find themselves in.

highlights.title: Ways to Push It Further
highlights.description: Run a sponsor edition with branded tiles and rewards, add a tournament or leaderboard layer across guests or time slots, or carry each contribution into another module, a personal recap, or a post-event reward flow.

highlights.title: Same Wall, Any Story
highlights.description: Re-skin it as a seasonal festive wall, a museum or education piece that reveals facts as the image fills, or a brand-activation scenario where every contribution builds a product or campaign world.

highlights.title: See Who Joined In
highlights.description: Add a data layer that logs contributions, active participants, completion, dwell time, and content choices, then export it for a post-event report or link it to tokens and galleries for personal follow-up.

highlights.title: Plugs Into the Wider Journey
highlights.description: Pair it with Visitor Identificator so each tile ties back to a known visitor, feed it with photos from Connected Photographer or Shared Gallery, and let Journey Recap fold the finished wall into each person's post-visit story.
